text: Unite word and deed. Your word must gain weight. If you said it, then you definitely did it! This creates a reputation for you in the eyes of others and, more importantly, forms your inner core. Your promises are especially important. Do not make empty promises either to yourself or to others. Avoid ambiguities when a feeling may arise that you promised something you actually do not intend to do. In modern society, the idea is instilled that deceiving (suckers) is normal and that this is the path to success. But feel the subtle difference between deception and cunning. Do not perform actions that lead to karma you do not wish for yourself.
